title: Foundation Course 1: Introduction to the Soil Food Web
line: Before compost, before teas, before microscopy, you must understand how the soil ecosystem actually functions. This course teaches the biological relationships that drive nutrient cycling, plant health, and long-term soil fertility.

title: Foundation Course 2: Biocomplete™ Compost
line: Foundation Course 2 teaches you how to create biologically complete compost that rebuilds soil life. Learn proper materials, pile management, and application methods to support nutrient cycling, soil structure, and long-term plant health.

title: Foundation Course 3: BioComplete™ Liquid Amendments
line: Foundation Course 3 teaches you how to prepare and apply biologically correct compost extracts and teas. Learn brewing principles, equipment use, and application strategies to deliver living microorganisms effectively and support soil health, plant

title: Foundation Course 4: Microscopy
line: Microscopy teaches you how to use a compound microscope to identify and quantify soil microorganisms. Learn to assess bacteria, fungi, protozoa, and nematodes, interpret biological data, and make informed decisions to improve soil health.

title: Soil Microscopy
line: Seeing is believing, and when it comes to the regeneration of living soil, a microscope is your most powerful ally: Become a Soil Food Web Lab Tech, See what your soil really needs before spending time and money to improve it, Measure the real impact of your efforts near instantly, No more sending samples across the country for assessment | Complete on-site assessments yourself

title: BioComplete™ Compost Production
line: Learn to produce biologically complete compost that restores soil life, suppresses disease, and transforms what’s possible on your land. Discover how to redirect organic waste into a biologically rich amendment, grow the right microbes to support healthy soil and plants while minimizing the risk of human pathogens and weed seeds, and replace expensive, harmful chemical inputs with the power of biology and organic matter.

title: Learn the Art and Science of Biological Liquid Amendments
line: Build on your Soil Food Web Microscopy and BioComplete™ Compost Production skills by learning to purposefully breed, multiply, and extract key microbes for various real world field application needs

title: Advanced Field Trial
line: You've learned to see life in a microscope slide. You've built biologically complete compost from the ground up. You've brewed and applied biological liquid amendments. You understand, at a cellular level, what healthy soil looks like and why it matters. Now it's time to prove it in the field.

title: Permaculture Design Certification
line: Whole-system design: water, plants, structures, community, rooted in living soil.

title: Introduction to Ecosystem Restoration : Module 1
line: Build a strong foundation in ecosystem restoration and learn how healthy ecosystems function. Explore the key factors that shape ecosystems, including soil, biodiversity, climate, water, and species interactions, while gaining the knowledge to recognize ecosystem degradation and support the restoration of healthy, resilient land.

title: Introduction to Ecosystem Restoration : Module 2
line: Explore how species, ecological cycles, and natural processes work together to shape healthy ecosystems. Learn about invasive and keystone species, food webs, nutrient cycles, ecosystem services, ecological succession, marine ecosystems, and nature-based solutions for restoring and protecting our environment.

title: Introduction to Ecosystem Restoration : Module 3
line: Move from ecological theory into practical restoration principles. Explore ecosystem restoration strategies, site assessment, abiotic and biotic factors, aquatic impacts, population ecology, and real-world case studies to understand how damaged ecosystems can be assessed and restored.

title: Introduction to Ecosystem Restoration : Module 4
line: Take ecosystem restoration from theory to practice. Learn about restoration standards, natural recovery, seed collection and propagation, planting strategies, species-level restoration, population ecology, and real-world restoration projects.

title: Mini Foundation Course
kicker: This Is Where It All Began
line: Learn directly from the source with this Intro to the Foundations Mini Course. A 10-lesson mini course into the world of Living Soil and all the ways it can help regenerate the world's living systems. Walk away with a broad view of just how impactful this work can be when applied consistently by educated land stewards and practitioners.

title: Workshops
line: Build BioComplete™ Compost, create biological liquid amendments, and practice microscopy alongside Dr. Elaine's team of experienced mentors and an international community.
